caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of blue and green, with darker tones indicating its curved contours and shadows. The handle is attached on the right side, smoothly arching from the pitcher’s rim to its side. The top of the pitcher has an open circular mouth with a small, rounded spout visible on the left. The bottom of the pitcher is thicker and more rounded, with a visible circular base. The artist has used shading and highlights to give the glass a translucent, reflective quality. There is a small, handwritten signature in red or brown ink to the right of the pitcher, near its base. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the drawing.
title: Pitcher
